test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q and R can complete a task together in 15 days. P and R can complete the task together in 40 days. In how many days can Q complete the task alone?
solution:
**Given:**

P, Q and R can complete a task together in 15 days.

P and R can complete the task together in 40 days.

**Calculation:**

(P + Q + R) can complete a work in = 15 days

So,

(P + Q + R)’s 1 day’s work = 1/40 ….. (1)

(P + R) can complete a work in = 40 days

So, (P + R)’s 1 day’s work = 1/40 ..... (2)

From (1) and (2) we get, ∴

Q’s 1 day’s work,

⇒ 1/15 – 1/40

⇒ (8 – 3)/120

⇒ 5/120

⇒ 1/24

**∴ Q can complete the work in 24 days.**
